components.css: .ds-palette{font-family:"Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei","PingFang SC",sans-serif;position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:9px 13px;background:#f8fafd;border:1px solid #e3e8f1;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden}.ds-palette>span:first-child{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#56647e);margin-right:3px}.ds-swatch{width:19px;height:19px;background:var(--swatch);border:3px solid transparent;background-clip:padding-box;border-radius:50%;padding:0;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}.ds-swatch[aria-pressed=true]{outline:1px solid var(--swatch);outline-offset:2px}.ds-swatch:hover{transform:scale(1.12)}.ds-swatch:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #6383e6;outline-offset:4px}.ds-dwell{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;height:3px;background:var(--blue,#3158d5);width:var(--dwell,0%);transition:width .05s linear}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-dwell{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
The Quiet Drawing Studio is calm, precise, and approachable. Pale blue surrounds white working surfaces, deep navy makes compact Chinese controls readable, and cobalt gives actions a clear visual center. The system keeps the artwork brighter and more spatially generous than its surrounding instruments.

Controls feel restrained and responsive: thin dividing lines, gently curved rectangular panels, small outline SVG icons, and factual state text. Color belongs to the user's ink and to meaningful interaction states; decorative depth stays minimal.
keyCharacteristics: White work surfaces on a cool pale-blue shell.
Compact CJK interface type with explicit action and status labels.
Cobalt actions, warm drawing ink, and quiet outlined containers.
Flat panels with visible keyboard focus and accessible alternate input.

rules.name: The Action and Ink Rule
rules.body: Use cobalt for primary interface actions; preserve the selected artwork color independently of interface state.

rules.name: The Readable Instrument Rule
rules.body: Reuse the 12px functional label scale; do not inherit the smaller brand strapline or isolated 11px mobile exceptions as a control-text standard.

rules.name: The Paper Proportion Rule
rules.body: Preserve the 16:10 drawing surface when reflowing the surrounding studio.

rules.name: The Flat Instrument Rule
rules.body: Keep persistent panels flat; use the notification shadow for temporary feedback.

dos: Do keep primary actions cobalt and user-selected drawing ink independent.
Do preserve the drawing paper's 16:10 proportion across responsive layouts.
Do use fine borders and tonal insets to group persistent instruments.
Do retain native controls, explicit state text, pressed states, and visible keyboard focus.
Do honor reduced motion and keep alternate pointer input available.
donts: Don't elevate persistent panels with the toast's shadow.
Don't turn the mobile brand strapline or isolated 11px exceptions into a functional-label token.
Don't rely on color alone to communicate input source or tracking state.
Don't replace the existing outline SVG icon language with typographic glyph icons.
